note: U6: which handler an UNHANDLED cleanup raise reaches when it replaces the completion being unwound (06A Decision 4). Emacs delivers the replacement to the ENCLOSING handler, `(OUT (error "cleanup"))'. Fe delivers it to a handler established in the ABANDONED BODY -- here the body's own `condition-case', which the `throw' had already left -- and answers `IN'. Cause: `RunOneCleanupEntry' replays the completion after restoring the frame stack the drain started from, which still holds the abandoned computation's handler frames; Emacs unwinds as it goes and no longer has them. Pre-existing on every revision since the rule was implemented, and found post-close by a review that re-measured the area, not introduced by Phase 12.
